source.branch: Debug #migratemons chooses stronghold-to-valley, next-depth or bottom no-destination; list groups pending monsters by current/next/other destinations and optionally renders a sorted window. DEBUG_MIGRATING_MONS accepts a count, clamps it, creates random monsters for positive counts or migrates existing fmon for negative counts, temporarily enabling generation and restoring debug_mongen.

Source-pinned tests must pin all comparisons and equal-id zero.

list_migrating_mons counts current first, next second, else other, emits either empty feedback or source plural counts, builds c/n/o choices and ESC suffix for empty categories, uses canonical yn_function default q, and emits None for an empty non-q category. Selected arrays are always sorted, including current/next. Rows reuse minimal_monnam(FALSE), remove only the literal <0,0> substring, append given names, include destination only for other/all, and append exact-coordinate metadata only for MIGR_EXACT_XY. Await source NHW_TEXT display/dismiss; no RNG here.

wiz_migrate_mons chooses valley from stronghold, otherwise get_level(depth+1), or zero destination at bottom. Source config.h620-621 enables DEBUG_MIGRATING_MONS under recorder DEBUG. Save debug_mongen before listing; initialize input, return ECMD_OK on ESC/empty, use atoi prefix/sign semantics, negative means migrate existing fmon, clamp counts to (COLNO-1)*ROWNO. Set debug_mongen FALSE only after valid count handling; for each positive count call rndmonst before makemon(ptr,0,0,MM_NOMSG), then migrate a non-null monster to next ledger/MIGR_RANDOM. Negative loop rereads fmon each iteration. Restore generation flag after loop; command has no time use beyond its source callbacks.

Whole source/caller search finds only cmd.c1770 direct command entry, wizcmds.c1892 list call, and wizcmds.c1585 comparator callback. JS has none of these three declarations or the dispatch arm. Existing minimal_monnam is whole-source credited in port-do_name-seed4500 and preserves valid species/name branches. Current makemon_runtime/rndmonst and dog migration bodies were read; retain named owner frontiers instead of inventing operations or claiming their completion.
